description: This file defines the 'UserAuthProvider' entity class which models the authentication provider linked to a user, supporting types like local and LDAP. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: UserAuthProvider
classes.description: Entity class representing a user's authentication provider, including details like provider type and LDAP attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the auth provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the auth provider.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this auth provider.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the provider type (local or LDAP).

methods.name: getLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Gets the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: setLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: getLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Gets the LDAP user's unique ID.

methods.name: setLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user's unique ID.
